author_claim: In Romans 9:25, Paul quotes Hosea 2:25 LXX, applying future promise verbs to Gentile believers to demonstrate that their calling into God's mercy aligns with scriptural prophecy.
short_quote: Indem es Heiden diejenigen 'Auszeichnungen' verheißend zuspricht, 'die Israel besaß und besitzt', erweist es die Berechtigung der paulinischen Darstellung...
qualification: Hosea originally addressed northern Israel, but Paul interprets 'not my people' as applying directly to the calling of Gentiles.
notes: Part of Rom 9:25-29 catena linking Hosea and Isaiah (Isa 10:22f.; 1:9).

author_claim: Paul combines Hosea 2:1 LXX with Hosea 2:25 LXX in Romans 9:25-26 to establish that Gentiles receive divine sonship in the very location of their former alienation.
short_quote: In der Tat kann der Apostel die Zitatkombination ihrem Wortlaut zufolge kaum anders denn als Rede über Heiden verstanden haben...
qualification: Paul presupposes that 'not my people' is an intuitive and self-evident description of Gentiles for his readers.
notes: Catchword connection via klethesontai back to ekalesen in Rom 9:24.

author_claim: In Romans 10:11, Paul modifies Isaiah 28:16bβ LXX by changing οὐ μὴ καταισχυνθῇ to οὐ καταισχυνθήσεται to harmonize with the future-tense framework of the surrounding context, and prefixes πᾶς to emphasize universal salvation.
short_quote: Die rein stilistische Modifikation — Paulus schreibt 'οὐ καταισχυνθήσεται' statt 'οὐ μὴ καταισχυνθῇ' — dürfte in dem Bestreben begründet sein, das Zitat in das von Futura durchzogene Umfeld einzupassen.
qualification: The prefixing of pas in Rom 10:11 (absent in LXX and Rom 9:33) prepares for the universal scope of Rom 10:12-13.
notes: Classified as partially revised Greek Old Testament text with deliberate authorial stylistic adjustment.

author_claim: Paul interprets the 'stone in Zion' (Isaiah 28:16) christologically: in Romans 9:33 as a dual stumbling-stone/salvation figure, and in Romans 10:11 as an unmixed universal promise of vindication for all who believe.
short_quote: So begreift er beide Jesajaworte als Hinweise auf Christus, der als eine, in sich identische Person nach der einen Seite Juden und Heiden Gerechtigkeit verleiht...
qualification: Although God is the speaker in Isaiah 28:16, the lithos is identified by Paul as Jesus Christ as proclaimed in the Gospel.
notes: Refined per self-audit to distinguish 9:33 dual aspect from 10:11 unmixed promise.

author_claim: In Romans 10:13, Paul quotes Joel 3:5a LXX verbatim, using πᾶς to connect with Isaiah 28:16 in Rom 10:11 and transferring the Old Testament formula for calling on the Lord God to the confession of Jesus as Lord.
short_quote: ...demgegenüber unterstreicht die Anspielung auf Joel 35a die Verbindung von κύριος-Homologie und Rettung.
qualification: In Joel 3:5, kyrios refers to YHWH, but Paul's argument in Rom 10:9-13 explicitly identifies kyrios with Jesus.
notes: Catchword pas unites Isa 28:16 (Rom 10:11), the theological premise (10:12), and Joel 3:5 (10:13).

author_claim: In Romans 11:34, Paul quotes Isaiah 40:13 LXX; Wilk hypothesizes that Paul likely inserted ἤ before τίς σύμβουλος to split the citation into a two-part rhetorical question matching the paired concepts of God's wisdom and knowledge in Romans 11:33.
short_quote: Angesichts der schwachen Bezeugung von ἤ in der 𝔊-Tradition steht zu vermuten, daß Paulus es in Rom 1134, zur Angleichung an 1135, selbst eingefügt hat.
qualification: Wilk qualifies this as a probabilistic scholarly inference ('steht zu vermuten, daß Paulus es... selbst eingefügt hat') based on the weak attestation of ἤ in the Greek manuscript tradition of Isa 40:13, recognizing this as a secondary-author hypothesis rather than a direct primary-text certainty.
notes: Classified by Wilk as a zitatähnliche Anspielung perfectly adapted to the structure of Rom 11:33.

author_claim: Paul uses Isaiah 40:13 in Romans 11:34 to highlight that God's sovereign and unexpected plan for Israel's salvation—encompassing temporary hardening and Gentile inclusion—transcends human comprehension.
short_quote: ...bringt es den wunderbaren Charakter des — von Menschen nur demütig nach- und mitzuvollziehenden — Heilshandelns Gottes an Israel gebündelt zur Sprache.
qualification: The first question of Rom 11:34 addresses God's merciful decree of salvation, while the second addresses His execution of that decree.
notes: Forms the climax of the overarching Rom 9-11 theological argument.

author_claim: In Romans 15:12, Paul quotes the substantive clauses of Isaiah 11:10a LXX verbatim, deliberately omitting ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ because he considers the promised 'Root of Jesse' to have already appeared in Jesus Christ; Wilk notes textual reservations on a possible Hebraizing Vorlage.
short_quote: Diese Zeitangabe kann entfallen, da nach Meinung des Apostels — wie sie in Röm 158 zum Ausdruck kommt — die verheißene 'Wurzel Isais' mit Jesus Christus bereits erschienen ist.
qualification: Wilk explicitly notes on p. 238 n. 28 that the possibility of a pre-Pauline Hebraizing revision in Paul's Vorlage remains under textual reservation due to lack of direct evidence for Isa 11; secondary-author claim subject to textual reservation.
notes: Refined per self-audit to document explicit textual reservation on Vorlage.

author_claim: Paul places Isaiah 11:10 at the climax of his quotation chain in Romans 15:9–12 to demonstrate that Christ's reign over the Gentiles grounds the united praise of Jewish and Gentile believers.
short_quote: Sie erklärt Christus — wie ihn sein Evangelium bezeugt... zum Garanten der Gemeinschaft von Juden- und Heidenchristen...
qualification: Christ's rule over the Gentiles is inseparably bound to His role as a servant to the circumcised (διάκονον... περιτομῆς) in Rom 15:8.
notes: Culmination of the fourfold scriptural proof (Ps 17:50, Deut 32:43, Ps 116:1, Isa 11:10) resolving the Strong and Weak conflict.

author_claim: In 1 Corinthians 1:19, Paul cites Isaiah 29:14b LXX, substituting ἀθετήσω ('I will set aside') for LXX κρύψω ('I will hide'), possibly influenced by Psalm 32:10 LXX, to express that God actively invalidates human wisdom.
short_quote: Demgegenüber läßt das — vielleicht durch Ps 3210(𝔊) vermittelte — Wort ἀθετεῖν... den Sinn der jesajanischen Prophetie in ihrer paulinischen Deutung deutlicher zutage treten.
qualification: Wilk rejects the theory that atheteso is an accidental memory lapse, maintaining that Paul made an intentional lexical substitution to clarify prophetic meaning.
notes: Classified as quotation from G* with intentional authorial clarification (Verdeutlichung).

author_claim: Paul uses Isaiah 29:14 in 1 Corinthians 1:19 as scriptural proof that God's saving act in the cross of Christ intentionally destroys human intellectual self-reliance as a means of knowing God.
short_quote: Sie erlaubt es Paulus, das Gericht Gottes über die Weisheit jüdischer und hellenistischer Provenienz als notwendige Kehrseite des Heilsgeschehens in Christus darzustellen...
qualification: Human wisdom in this context encompasses both Jewish rabbinic/scribal tradition and Hellenistic philosophy.
notes: Begründendes Zitat anchoring the whole thesis of 1 Cor 1:18-25.

author_claim: In Galatians 3:13, Paul substitutes ἐπικατάρατος for Old Greek κεκατηραμένος in Deuteronomy 21:23a to assimilate to the wording of Deuteronomy 27:26 as cited in Galatians 3:10.
short_quote: Eine Analogie bietet Gal 313, wo Paulus — zur Angleichung an das Dtn-Zitat in Gal 310 — das Dtn 2123a eröffnende Wort κεκατηραμένος gegen ἐπικατάρατος austauscht...
source_locator: Teil II.1.2.1.3b, S. 47 Anm. 1 (vgl. S. 94 Anm. 32; S. 152 Anm. 43)
qualification: Wilk cites Koch (Schrift 165f.) for the textual observation and notes this intentional authorial assimilation as an analogy for Pauline adjustments elsewhere.
notes: Passing text-critical footnote demonstrating authorial quotation assimilation; Deut 21:23 absent from OT index.
